annotations.text:
States the design screenshot never showed.

Every card keeps the same anatomy as the loaded state - 40px icon box, flexible main column, right-hand slot - so the card never reflows structurally as it moves between states.

Tokens, spacing and type are lifted from client/src/vendor/ui/styles.css and the existing verdict banner, card, section-label, badge, score-ring and empty-state primitives.
